units.meshConversion: glTF Z must be negated on ingestion

preset.attributes: configured final stats; prototype defaults explicitly documented
preset.passives: explicit RF passive IDs; currently supported combat branches 24401/24405
preset.doubleTapWindowSeconds: experimental only; omitted disables guessed double-tap window

samplers.effectSampler(effect, owner, context): original effect-template pose and sphere shapes; caller must use birthActorPose/birthAnchor when TRACE and TRACE_MORE are false
samplers.effectAnchorSampler(effect, owner, conte: optional {position:[nativeX,Y,Z], ...source-backed transform metadata}; captured at birth into snapshot

shape.radius: original stored KSM radius or explicitly labelled reference geometric candidate

methods.step(dtSeconds,input): finite >0 <=0.25, caller owns fixed timestep; no inherited 120Hz
methods.configureLoadout(slots,actorId): eight null/{skillId,branchId:'none'} entries; RF ownership, bans, uniqueness, executor support checked; resolves final enhanced replacement and master level
methods.snapshot(): JSON-serializable state including time/actors/effects/birth anchors/RNG/events/counters/frozen versions
methods.drainEvents(): returns ordered events and clears queue
methods.injectHit(fixture): internal fixture only, never a public match input

input.aliases: ArrowLeft/Right/Up/Down, Ctrl/Control are normalized; uppercase invariant
